0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Rockets host the Mavericks, and Houston is missing Julian Phillips and Steven Adams, who are both day-to-day with illness and calf soreness, respectively. Dallas also has four players listed as day-to-day: Dereck Lively II (foot, following surgery), Jett Howard (illness), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Houston won the most recent meeting 111-107 in Houston on January 31, 2026.
